Package index

API Client & Authentication

Functions for API key management and direct HTTP datastream requests.

senace_set_key()
Set the SENACE API key
senace_api_key()
Retrieve the active SENACE API key
senace_get_data()
Retrieve data from a SENACE datastream
senace_list_datasets()
List datasets available from SENACE

Datastream Helpers

Convenience functions for fetching SENACE datasets (with offline support).

senace_cartera_proyectos()
Retrieve the Sustainable Investment Project Portfolio
senace_consultoras_ambientales()
Retrieve the Environmental Consulting Firms Register
senace_gastos_especifica()
Retrieve expenditure by detailed classifier
senace_gastos_fuente()
Retrieve expenditure by funding source
senace_gastos_generica()
Retrieve expenditure by generic classifier
senace_solicitudes_acceso()
Retrieve public information access requests
senace_visitas()
Retrieve the Institutional Visits Register
senace_reclamos()
Retrieve the Complaints and Claims Register

Bundled Offline Datasets

Packaged local data objects available for offline analysis.

cartera_proyectos_data
Sustainable Investment Project Portfolio (Local Data)
consultoras_ambientales_data
Environmental Consulting Firms Register (Local Data)
gasto_especifica_data
Expenditure by Detailed Classifier (Local Data)
gasto_fuente_data
Expenditure by Funding Source (Local Data)
gasto_generica_data
Expenditure by Generic Classifier (Local Data)
solicitud_acceso_data
Public Information Access Requests (Local Data)
visitas_data
Institutional Visits Register (Local Data)
reclamos_data
Complaints and Claims Register (Local Data)
